correction.agent: Muse subagent (C4 freeze-gate repair worker; session 4413edc7)
correction.occasion: Main-branch CI job 'Freeze gate records check' (checker --all) failed on this spec in runs 41155682213, 41157454467 and 41167817221; PR-scope runs never exercised these paths. The C4 gate requires its records to mean what they say, so the defect is repaired by correction, in the open: this entry, the per-quantity correction notes, gate-records/CORRECTION-2026-10-31.md beside this record, and an entry in LEDGER.md.
what_was_wrong: Five quantities (registry_v1_rows, crosswalk_rows, anchors_sha256, total_analyzable_rows, documented_lineage_rows_total) carried recomputed values and status 'agree' while marked sampled: false. Under the checker's definition an unsampled quantity has no checked status; the filed statuses were therefore unsupported as filed.
coverage.other_checked was filed as 8, but under the checker's definition (non-gate-turning quantities that are sampled and carry a checked status) the filed sampling supported only 3.
The companion C3 record's verifier was this record's drafting session; repaired in that record's own correction entry.
what_changed: The five quantities were independently recomputed by the correcting agent on 2026-10-31 from the underlying sources named in their notes; all five agree with their pins. They are now marked sampled on the strength of that recomputation, each note carrying its correction sentence. The scaffold's seeded draw (seed 20261025) was re-run and reproduces the originally filed sample exactly, confirming the five stood outside the drawn sample; the correction pass extends the sample beyond the draw, which the sample rule permits (it sets a minimum sample, not a maximum).
coverage.other_sampled corrected 3 -> 8 to match the quantities list as corrected; coverage.other_checked stands at 8, now true under the checker's definition.
correction.what_did_not_change: Every pinned value, every recomputed value, the sample rule, the drafter and recomputer attestations, and the outcome stand exactly as filed. The as-filed record is preserved in git history at commit fa34a92b (the Spec 075 freeze commit).
